takes.text:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, restaurant kitchen documentary, warm tungsten light, handheld, one continuous take. Evening service begins. The camera tracks the moving subject. A barista in their twenties, freckled and soft-spoken, with snow-white hair slicked straight back, small silver hoops along both ears and a burn scar on one wrist, wearing a puffy black winter jacket zipped to the chin tears the first ticket from the printer at the pass and calls it out to the kitchen. The shot ends as a cook spins toward the wok station.

overall_soundscape: A ticket printer chattering, pans clanging, and the chef's shout.

non_diegetic_music: A fast brushed jazz drum at a low volume.

a puffy black winter jacket zipped to the chin
